# Rule map draft: Operation & Maintenance (Power Fx vs code app TypeScript)

**Draft**, generated by `node scripts/gen-parity-manifest.mjs "Opex Costs Screen.pa.yaml" --app projectcosts --slug opex` on 2026-11-03. Every
code, UT and Playwright column is TODO: fill each by reading the code app, then merge the rows into `RULEMAP-opex.md`
(or rename this file to it when there is none). Running the generator again overwrites this draft.
Shape follows `RULEMAP-land-lease.md`.

**Sources**
- Canvas (ground truth): `ProjectDocs/_extracted/msapp/projectcosts/Src/Opex Costs Screen.pa.yaml` (230 controls). Cited `PA:<line>`.
- Opened by: the Cost app's left menu "Operation & Maintenance"; code route `/costs/opex/om`.
- Code app files matched for test ids: `src/features/cost/periods/OpexScreen.tsx`.
- Manifest draft: `ProjectCosts-CodeApp/e2e/screens/opex/manifest.draft.ts`.

**Method:** the YAML was read with `scripts/lib/paYaml.mjs`. Every formula below is the live one: `/* */` and `//`
comments are removed first (CONVENTIONS rule 10). Long formulas are collapsed to one line and trimmed.

**Counts:** 230 controls · 11 inputs (10 with an error label) · 10 messages · 9 command-bar items · 14 buttons · 1 Dataverse tables written.
